failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the prior 4-week mean despite sustained improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT for four consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed slide in TRANSIT below its recent level reduces optional shopping trips and city-center errands, so RETAIL_REC should fall within one to two weeks after a clear transit setback.

evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has hovered near -45 and remained far below baseline in all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within two weeks after TRANSIT crosses from above -45 to below -45.

evidence_refs: fact:both series remain negative but moved closer to baseline than at t-3w
